items.headline: 16-unit apartment building permitted on Bradford Way
items.summary: A $1.8 million permit was issued for new construction of a 16-unit multi-family building at 1803 Bradford Wy, one of the larger residential projects in this batch of permits.

items.headline: New business 'gloo' permitted signage on Olive Ave
items.summary: Signage reading 'gloo' — including a large aluminum sign, two smaller ones, and window graphics — was permitted at 412 Olive Ave, pointing to a new tenant moving into the North Ventura area.

items.headline: Three prefab ADUs permitted at same Rubino Drive complex
items.summary: Permits were issued for three Villa Homes prefab accessory dwelling units near Building 'D' at 3180 Rubino Dr (#121, #123 and #125), each valued around $117,000, suggesting a multi-unit prefab ADU rollout at this address.

items.headline: PopUp Bagels signage permitted at 164 University Ave
items.summary: A permit for non-illuminated canopy and hanging signs reading 'PopUp Bagels' was issued for 164 University Ave, signaling the bagel chain's move into downtown Palo Alto.

items.headline: Council to consider business tax overhaul for ballot
items.summary: The City Council is set to consider a resolution putting a Business Tax Modernization Measure before voters, which would shift Milpitas to a gross receipts tax structure tied more closely to a business's actual economic activity. The city says about 85% of Milpitas businesses have small enough gross receipts that they would be protected under the new tiered system.
